full_details: The jaw was tender for the last day, and the hole where the tooth was has closed over. At the Theatre you worked the Capulet house on the morning of a wedding: cooks sent for, a father who cannot stop giving orders, the curfew, the baked meats. Tom read old Capulet plain, down to the spices, and the plainness was the danger. Kemp, as a serving-man, waited where no wait was written, and Nick laughed. You wrote the one word in the margin. You said you saw it. You did not promise more. You told them a kitchen in a hurry is part of the clock, and that the house must be believed before the lovers can outrun it. You were not in the afternoon king. At home you took the soft side again and did not call yourself well.
one_sentence: Pope played the father flat, Kemp found a pause, Nick laughed, and you wrote the pause in.
title: The pause written in, and the jaw's last tender day
